questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this middleware keeps credentials out of the logs? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A chunk upload to `/v1/files/:fileId/chunks/:index` fails with a 500. What does the error log contain for `body`?
choices: The first 256 characters of the raw chunk bytes
Nothing: `bodyPreview` returns undefined for application/octet-stream requests
A base64 encoding of the chunk

questions.prompt: What determines whether headers, query and body are written to a log line?
choices: Whether the response status is 500 or above
Whether the request carried an x-request-id header

questions.prompt: A client calls `POST /v1/sync/cursor?Share_Key=abc` and the handler throws, producing a 500. How is the query parameter logged?
choices: As "[redacted]", because the key is lowercased before the lookup
As "abc", because the set only contains lowercase names
It is dropped from the log entirely
The request is rejected before logging because of the unknown parameter
